# Menu 251 (bone scale and add) on every bone key of chain8_ik.pmx with swing600.vmd.
# The 12 values are the dialog's (scale, add) pairs in edit-id order
# 686..697: position x, y, z, rotation x, y, z (add in degrees).
load model chain8_ik.pmx
load vmd swing600.vmd
select all bone
multiply bone 2 0.5 1 0 1 -1 0.5 10 1 0 1 -15
save pmm multiplied.pmm
select all bone
save vmd multiplied.vmd
